title: Queue for servers
description: a data pack that adds a queue when you login in to the server
body:
this datapack adds a queue to the server for each new player. When you first log in, no one can leave the respawn point until the administrator writes the following commands in the chat:

For reomve queue:

```
/tag @a add not_in_queue
```

For add queue


```
/tag @a remove not_in_queue
```
 This datapack is still in the early stages of development, and there may be some flaws in it. I will improve it to perfection in the future.
